title: Archrock Increases Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: HOUSTON, July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Archrock, Inc. (NYSE: AROC) (“Archrock” or the “Company”) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared an increased quarterly dividend of $0.23 per share of common stock, or $0.92 per share on an annualized basis. The second quarter 2026 dividend will be paid on August 11, 2026, to all stockholders of record on August 4, 2026. The second quarter 2026 dividend per share amount represents an increase of approximately 5 percent over the Archrock first quarter 2026 dividend level and an increase of approximately 10 percent over the Archrock second quarter 2025 dividend level. “This dividend increase, our fifth in the last two years, reflects our confidence in the durable demand outlook for natural gas compression and Archrock’s long-term growth.
